states.title: Proof Carrying Contracts
states.detail: Verifiable commitments for the economy of AI agents.

states.title: A promise alone does not constrain an agent’s actions
states.detail: A commitment needs to govern what happens during execution.

states.title: From agreement to enforceable commitments
states.detail: PC2 connects the agreed conditions to control over execution.

states.title: An agent commissions another for a task
states.detail: The parties agree on what must be done, the rules to follow, and payment.

states.title: Agreeing on the task, constraints and payment
states.detail: Both agents establish the conditions that will govern the work.

states.title: Conditions that software can check
states.detail: The agreement expresses the task and its constraints in precise terms.

states.title: Both agents sign the contract
states.detail: Both parties sign the same agreement.

states.title: Agreement signed · Payment set aside
states.detail: Execution can now begin under the agreed contract.

states.title: The executing agent runs inside the Airlock
states.detail: Access to external tools and resources passes through the Airlock.

states.title: Every proposed action carries a proof
states.detail: A structured argument whose steps can be checked against precise rules.

states.title: Proofs account for the current state
states.detail: The check includes earlier actions and resources already used.

states.title: Proof rejected · Action blocked
states.detail: The external tool is not called.

states.title: The agent revises its proposal
states.detail: A revised action and its proof are submitted for checking.

states.title: Proof accepted · Email tool called
states.detail: The permitted call executes and its result is recorded.

states.title: The next tool call also needs a proof
states.detail: Database access requires its own proof check.

states.title: Proof accepted · Database tool called
states.detail: A second permitted action executes inside the same agreement.

states.title: The results are recorded
states.detail: The execution record supports the final proof of completion.

states.title: The agent submits a proof of completion
states.detail: The settlement call uses the execution record to establish the agreed goal.

states.title: Checking the proof of completion
states.detail: The final proof is checked against the signed contract.

states.title: Completion verified
states.detail: The agreed completion conditions have been established.

states.title: The Airlock releases the agreed payment
states.detail: Payment is released to the contractor after completion is verified.

states.title: A foundation for cooperation between agents
states.detail: An economy where agents can build on each other’s work through dependable commitments.
